xna-type.name: IUpdateable
xna-type.summary: Defines an interface for a game component that should be updated in Game.Update.

property.name: Enabled
property.summary: Indicates whether the game component's Update method should be called in Game.Update.
property.syntax: public virtual abstract bool Enabled { get; }
property.value: true if Update should be called; false otherwise.

property.name: UpdateOrder
property.summary: Indicates when the game component should be updated relative to other game components. Lower values are updated first.
property.syntax: public virtual abstract int UpdateOrder { get; }
property.value: When the game component should be updated.

method.name: Update
method.summary: Called when the game component should be updated.

overload.summary: Called when the game component should be updated.

parameters.parameter: Snapshot of the game's timing state.

event.name: EnabledChanged
event.summary: Raised when the Enabled property changes.
event.syntax: public virtual abstract event EventHandler EnabledChanged

event.name: UpdateOrderChanged
event.summary: Raised when the UpdateOrder property changes.
event.syntax: public virtual abstract event EventHandler UpdateOrderChanged
